prompt: In csv.js, parseCsvLine(line) must split one CSV line into an array of strings. Fields are separated by commas. A field that starts with a double quote is quoted: it ends at the next double quote that is not doubled, a doubled double quote inside it stands for one literal double quote, and commas inside it are part of the value. Unquoted fields are returned exactly as written, including any spaces. Empty fields are kept, so 'a,,b' has three fields and a trailing comma adds a final empty field. An empty line gives [''] (one empty field). After a closing quote only a comma or the end of the line may follow. Throw an Error for an unterminated quoted field or for any other character after a closing quote. Quotes in the middle of an unquoted field are ordinary characters.
